name: Home Actions
_setup_notes: Import this file into n8n via Settings → Import workflow.
Required nodes to configure after import:
1. Webhook — POST /webhook/home-action; triggered by OpenClaw or chat
2. HTTP Request (LiteLLM) — classify intent: read vs write, entity, service
3. IF node — branch: read-only vs state-changing
4. Home Assistant Read — GET /api/states via HASS_TOKEN (auto-proceed for reads)
5. Wait node — MANDATORY approval gate for ALL state-changing actions
7. SQLite Insert — write audit row to db/assistant.db jobs table
The Wait node for step 5 must NOT be bypassed. All non-read HA actions require approval.
On HA API error: do not retry state-changing calls; surface error and require reviewer action.
